title: Tune on some warehouses, report on the others
heading: The Winner on the Training Set Looks Better Than It Is
cases: the choice is the best on the training set, scored on both sets against the default
a score is the shifted geometric mean of the configuration's work
held-out instances play no part in the choice
both ratios compare with the default, not with the best configuration
a tie goes to the earlier configuration, so the default wins a tie
the shift keeps a big ratio on a tiny instance from deciding the choice
